Hadith.Hadith: "Actions are judged by intentions." (Ref: Bukhari 1)
"A Muslim is one who avoids harming others with his tongue and hands." (Ref: Bukhari 10)
"None of you believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself." (Ref: Bukhari 13)
"Make things easy, not difficult; give glad tidings, not discouragement." (Ref: Bukhari 69)
"The strong person is not one who can wrestle, but one who controls his anger." (Ref: Bukhari 6114)
"Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or stay silent." (Ref: Bukhari 6018)
"Feed the hungry, visit the sick, and free the captives." (Ref: Bukhari 5649)
"The believer is not one who eats while his neighbor goes hungry." (Ref: Bukhari 6017)
"Be kind to others and you will receive kindness." (Ref: Muslim 2699)
"Allah loves gentleness in all matters." (Ref: Bukhari 6927)
"The best people are those who benefit others most." (Ref: Bukhari 2442)
"Paradise lies under the feet of your mother." (Ref: Ahmad 3/429)
"Every good deed is charity." (Ref: Muslim 1005)
"The upper hand is better than the lower hand." (Ref: Bukhari 1429)
"Modesty brings only good." (Ref: Bukhari 6117)
"Allah does not look at your bodies but at your hearts and deeds." (Ref: Muslim 2564)
"Help your brother whether he wrongs or is wronged." (Ref: Bukhari 2444)
"The most beloved deed to Allah is the most regular one." (Ref: Bukhari 6465)
"Whoever is not kind to people, Allah will not be kind to him." (Ref: Bukhari 7376)
"All of Adam's children make mistakes; the best are those who repent." (Ref: Tirmidhi 2499)
"Be merciful and you will receive mercy." (Ref: Ahmad 7001)
"The journey to seek knowledge is a path to Paradise." (Ref: Tirmidhi 2646)
"Every disease has a cure except death." (Ref: Bukhari 5678)
"The world is green and beautiful; Allah made you its guardians." (Ref: Muslim 2742)
"Whoever thanks people has thanked Allah." (Ref: Tirmidhi 1954)
"What is lawful is clear and what is unlawful is clear." (Ref: Bukhari 52)
"Worship Allah as if you see Him; if not, know that He sees you." (Ref: Bukhari 50)
"The believers are like one body in their love and mercy." (Ref: Bukhari 6011)
"Whoever hides a Muslim's fault, Allah will hide his faults." (Ref: Muslim 2699)
"The best believer is one with the best character." (Ref: Tirmidhi 1162)
"When one of you does work, Allah loves that he does it well." (Ref: Tabarani 891)
"The best companions remind you of Allah when you see them." (Ref: Tirmidhi 2395)
"No one believes until he wants for others what he wants for himself." (Ref: Bukhari 13)
"The best people live longest and do the best deeds." (Ref: Tirmidhi 2329)
"Whoever removes someone's worry, Allah will remove his worry." (Ref: Muslim 2699)
"A kind word is charity." (Ref: Bukhari 2989)
"The most perfect believers have the best manners." (Ref: Abu Dawud 4682)
"Be kind to animals; there is reward in serving any living being." (Ref: Bukhari 2466)
"The best jihad is speaking truth to an unjust ruler." (Ref: Abu Dawud 4344)
"Kindness is a sign of faith; whoever lacks kindness lacks faith." (Ref: Muslim 54)
"Visit the sick, feed the hungry, and help the troubled." (Ref: Bukhari 5649)
"The reward of good deeds depends on the intentions behind them." (Ref: Bukhari 1)
"Make it easy for people and do not make it hard for them." (Ref: Bukhari 220)
"Whoever wishes to be kept away from Hell and enter Paradise should treat people as they want to be treated." (Ref: Muslim 1844)
"The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it." (Ref: Bukhari 5027)

"A man walking along a path felt very thirsty and found a well, so he climbed down and drank. When he came up, he saw a dog panting from thirst, so he went back down and brought water for the dog. Allah thanked him and forgave his sins." (Ref: Bukhari 2466)

"Do not wish to be like anyone except in two cases: a man whom Allah has given wealth and he spends it righteously, and a man whom Allah has given wisdom and he acts and teaches it." (Ref: Bukhari 73)
"The person who goes to bed full while his neighbor is hungry is not one of us." (Ref: Tabarani 8720)
"Whoever says 'There is no god but Allah' will enter Paradise." (Ref: Bukhari 5827)
"The best houses are those where orphans are well treated." (Ref: Ibn Majah 3679)
"Allah will not show mercy to him who does not show mercy to others." (Ref: Bukhari 7376)
"A prostitute was forgiven by Allah because she gave water to a thirsty dog." (Ref: Bukhari 3467)
"The most beloved places to Allah are the mosques." (Ref: Muslim 671)
"Do not get angry and Paradise will be yours." (Ref: Bukhari 6116)
"The best wealth is a tongue that remembers Allah." (Ref: Tirmidhi 3375)
"Whoever relieves a Muslim of a burden from the burdens of the world, Allah will relieve him of a burden from the burdens of the Hereafter." (Ref: Muslim 2699)
"The believer who mixes with people and bears their annoyance with patience will have a greater reward than the believer who does not mix with people." (Ref: Ibn Majah 4032)
"Every act of kindness is charity." (Ref: Bukhari 2989)
"He who sleeps on a full stomach while his neighbor goes hungry is not one of us." (Ref: Hakim 7939)
"A good leader is one who when people see him, they remember Allah." (Ref: Tirmidhi 2325)
"Keep your duty to Allah wherever you are." (Ref: Tirmidhi 1987)
"No one has eaten better food than that which he has eaten out of the work of his hand." (Ref: Bukhari 2072)
"Allah has appointed a guardian for every person." (Ref: Bukhari 6502)
"The best prayer after the obligatory prayers is the night prayer." (Ref: Muslim 1163)
